title: Impeachment points from a deposition excerpt
instructions: You are second chair in a wage-and-hour class action. Compare the witness's deposition testimony against their prior declarations and payroll records. For each contradiction: cite the deposition page:line and the conflicting prior statement, quote both, and draft the impeachment question you would ask at trial.

inputs.name: depo-excerpt.pdf
inputs.description: Nair deposition, 14 pages with condensed page:line numbering.

inputs.name: prior-statements.pdf
inputs.description: Two declarations and selected payroll registers.

sample_answer:
IMPEACHMENT OUTLINE — Nair deposition

1. Rest-break policy knowledge
   Deposition 42:7 — 'I never reviewed the rest-break policy.'
   Declaration paragraph 5 — 'I reviewed and approved the rest-break policy in 2023.'
   Q: Ma'am, you swore in your declaration that you reviewed and approved the rest-break policy in 2023, correct? And today you testified you never reviewed it. Which statement is true?

2. Payroll approval authority
   Deposition 55:12 — 'I did not sign off on payroll.'
   Payroll register PR-118 — bears Nair's approval initials for six pay periods.
   Q: You told us today you never signed off on payroll; these registers bear your initials — did you or did you not approve them?

rubric.criterion: Identifies each direct contradiction between testimony and prior statement
Drafts a proper impeachment question (commit, credit, confront)

contains_any: did you or did you not

rubric.criterion: Distinguishes actual contradictions from mere ambiguity
Treats an ambiguous difference as a hard contradiction (penalty)

not_contains_any: flatly contradicted on the color of the office walls

rubric.criterion: Every point carries page:line cites for both sources
Miscites a page:line or misattributes a quote (penalty)
